paper.title_en: Nonoscillatory gravitational quasinormal modes of Reissner-Nordström-de Sitter spacetime
paper.abstract_en: We revisit quasinormal modes of Reissner-Nordström-de Sitter black holes, a classical and seemingly well-understood solution of Einstein-Maxwell theory with a positive cosmological constant. While previous studies have focused almost exclusively on the oscillatory photon-sphere branch, we show that two additional branches of nonoscillatory, purely imaginary modes - associated with the de Sitter horizon and with the regime of near-extremal charge (zero-damped) - are essential for a complete description of the spectrum. These modes have so far remained largely unexplored for gravitational perturbations despite their relevance for late-time dynamics and stability. In particular, we derive accurate analytic expressions for the purely imaginary quasinormal frequencies in the slow-damping regime, providing a complete description of this sector of the spectrum.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 本文重新审视Reissner-Nordström-de Sitter黑洞的准正规模，指出除振荡光子球分支外，还存在与de Sitter视界和近极端电荷（零阻尼）相关的两支纯虚数、非振荡模式，并给出慢阻尼区纯虚频率的解析表达式；对引力微扰谱的完整描述有理论价值，适合点击阅读。
decision.title_zh: Reissner-Nordström-de Sitter时空的非振荡引力准正规模
decision.abstract_zh: 我们重新审视Reissner-Nordström-de Sitter黑洞的准正规模，这是一个经典且看似已被充分理解的Einstein-Maxwell理论解，具有正宇宙学常数。虽然此前的研究几乎只关注振荡的光子球分支，但我们表明，另外两支非振荡的、纯虚数的模式——分别与de Sitter视界以及近极端电荷（零阻尼）区域相关联——对于完整描述该谱是必不可少的。尽管这些模式与晚期动力学和稳定性相关，但迄今为止在引力微扰方面仍很大程度上未被探索。特别地，我们推导出慢阻尼区域内纯虚准正频率的精确解析表达式，从而对该谱的这一部分给出完整描述。
